note: While FBXO11-related disorder is primarily a static neurodevelopmental disorder rather than progressive neurodegeneration, isolated developmental regression has been documented in rare cases.

evidence.text: A clinical study of 21 individuals with FBXO11-related disorder identified one individual who exhibited developmental regression of previously acquired skills, contradicting the absolute exclusion of regression.

source.title: Defining FBXO11-Related Neurodevelopmental Disorder: Clinical, Molecular and Facial Assessment of 21 Patients
